## Summary

Describe the change and affected user workflow.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests / smoke checks passed
- [ ] No unintended production-data changes

## Documentation

For every new user-visible feature or meaningful workflow change:

- [ ] `USER-MANUAL.md` updated
- [ ] Relevant `help-id` section updated/added for Context Help
- [ ] `ADMIN-GUIDE.md` updated if permissions/admin workflow changed
- [ ] `SYSTEM-FLOWS.md` updated if lifecycle/system flow changed
- [ ] Feature-specific technical docs updated when contracts/safeguards changed

If documentation is not applicable, explain why in the PR description.
